questionText: Refer to the given 3-address code sequence. This code sequence is split into basic blocks. The number of basic blocks is ________. (Answer in integer)
explanation:
To determine the number of basic blocks, we first need to identify the leaders (the first instructions of basic blocks):

1. Rule 1: The first instruction of the code sequence is a leader.
    • Instruction 1001 is a leader.

2. Rule 2: Any instruction that is the target of a conditional or unconditional jump/goto statement is a leader.
    • Target of line 1009 (`goto 1003`): Instruction 1003 is a leader.
    • Target of line 1011 (`goto 1002`): Instruction 1002 is a leader.
    • Target of line 1017 (`goto 1013`): Instruction 1013 is a leader.

3. Rule 3: Any instruction that immediately follows a jump/goto statement is a leader.
    • Following line 1009 (`goto 1003`): Instruction 1010 is a leader.
    • Following line 1011 (`goto 1002`): Instruction 1012 is a leader.

Set of Leaders: {1001, 1002, 1003, 1010, 1012, 1013}

Basic Blocks Formation:
• Block 1: 1001
• Block 2: 1002
• Block 3: 1003 to 1009
• Block 4: 1010 to 1011
• Block 5: 1012
• Block 6: 1013 to 1017

Thus, the total number of basic blocks is 6.
